svg.text: End the extension before renewal surprises
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Azure inventory, Cost Management and the separate license billing portal
Export only approved sanitized learning evidence. Before trial expiry, decide whether to
buy/renew the actual user and client licenses; disable recurring billing/cancel through the
provider’s process if not continuing. Do not assume deleting a VM cancels a license.
Remove the disposable VDI host, disks, workspace/application group/host pool and any extra
resources only after confirming nothing shared depends on them. Recheck for orphan disks,
snapshots, diagnostic workspaces and other meters.
Review delayed usage and the next invoice, update the inventory and keep the local free
practice path if the ongoing licensed cloud cost exceeds the goal. Record that this optional
VDI environment was retired rather than pretending it remains protected.
Check: The extension has a verified end state for both Azure resources and separate licenses.
